CAPTURES.description: Private R2 bucket for captured request bodies (`raw/`) and attachments (`files/`).

DB.description: D1 database for capture records. Created on first deploy; the Worker creates its own tables.

DASHBOARD_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the dashboard API. Generate a long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID. Used with CF_API_TOKEN to look up each host's Gateway application name.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: API token with **Account > Zero Trust > Read**. Optional: without it the application shows as unknown.

MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES.description: Max request-body bytes stored per capture (the full body always reaches the origin).

CAPTURE_OTHER.description: `false` stores only mail sends and attachments.
